2607.09438.title: Test-Time Scaling for Small VLMs on Multilingual Visual MCQ
2607.09438.paper_summary: Test-time scaling (TTS) reliably improves reasoning in large language models, but whether it transfers to small open vision-language models remains unclear. We examine this on EXAMS-V, a multilingual visual multiple-choice benchmark, comparing self-consistency, describe-then-reason with PRM-guided beam search, and two post-hoc selectors across Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct and Qwen3.5-4B. What matters is the conditions under which TTS runs, not the search or verification machinery. The largest factor is parseability: an early prompt format left many chains reasoning correctly yet never committing to an answer letter, which a standard answer cue and a guided repair step largely remove. A larger decoding budget removes the rest: raising the per-chain token limit from 1k to 2k recovers 3.7 pp, whereas sampling more chains (8 to 16) adds only 0.15 pp. Once chains have room to finish, elaborate methods contribute little: PRM-guided beam search trails plain self-consistency by 0.39 pp at over eight times the cost, and neither a training-free generative critic nor a trained multimodal PRM beats majority vote across both policies. The largest gain comes instead from the policy model itself (+11.4 pp). Our best configuration reaches 84.1% on the held-out ImageCLEF 2026 test split, ranking first on the Visual MCQ leaderboard.
2607.09438.paper_summary_zh: 測試時間縮放（TTS）可靠地提高了大型語言模型的推理能力，但這是否能轉移到小型開放視覺語言模型仍然不清楚。<lb/>我們在EXAMS-V上檢驗這一點，這是一個多語言視覺多選基準，對比自我一致性、描述後推理與PRM引導的束搜索，以及兩個事後選擇器，涵蓋Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct和Qwen3.5-4B。<lb/>重要的是TTS運行的條件，而不是搜索或驗證機制。<lb/>最大的因素是可解析性：一種早期的提示格式使許多鏈能正確推理卻從未承諾一個答案字母，而標準答案提示和引導修正步驟在很大程度上消除了這一點。<lb/>更大的解碼預算消除了其餘問題：將每鏈的標記限制從1k提高到2k恢復了3.7個百分點，而採樣更多鏈（從8到16）僅增加0.15個百分點。<lb/>一旦鏈有空間完成，複雜的方法貢獻不大：PRM引導的束搜索在成本超過八倍的情況下落後於普通自我一致性0.39個百分點，且無論是無需訓練的生成批評者還是訓練過的多模態PRM在兩種策略中都無法超過多數投票。<lb/>最大的增益反而來自於政策模型本身（+11.4個百分點）。<lb/>我們的最佳配置在保留的ImageCLEF 2026測試分割中達到84.1%，在視覺多選題排行榜中排名第一。
